boxes.note: Folders and scans per box of the scanned Nachlass; PDAI documents per box; Caltech sections named on cover sheets.

categories.note: Categories of the PDAI documents grouped as in series.yaml; docs, pages, units.

unit_types.note: Types of the non-blank content units.

years.note: Dated units per year (1895–1965), letters (letter, telegram, postcard), Kármán correspondence.

places.note: Writing places normalised to cities (places.yaml); per-year stream of the nine most frequent cities.

languages.note: Languages of dated units per decade.

correspondents.note: Counterparts of Kármán (ent_id 8) in units he sent or received; role labels excluded.

topics.note: Curated subject tags per decade (count and share of dated units).

manuscripts.note: Documents of the manuscript categories; years parsed from folder slugs; no date inferred.

period_check.note: Boundary checks of periods.yaml against the writing places per year.

periods.note: Per-period aggregates for the narrative Arbeitsperioden.

sources.note: Grounding sources on the history of aviation.

facts.note: Flat numbers used in the texts ({{key}} placeholders).

00_units.sql:
-- Content units of the PDAI collection, blank pages excluded.
-- y: year from date_when, NULL when undated or outside 1890–1970.
-- counterpart_id: the other party of a unit in which Kármán (ent_id 8) is sender or recipient.
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW u AS
SELECT
    l.letter_id,
    l.doc_id,
    l.letter_nr,
    l.page_start,
    l.doc_type,
    coalesce(l.place, '') AS place,
    l.date_when,
    CASE WHEN try_cast(substr(l.date_when, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1890 AND 1970
         THEN try_cast(substr(l.date_when, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) END AS y,
    coalesce(l.language, '') AS language,
    l.regest,
    l.topics,
    lr.sender_id,
    lr.recipient_id,
    CASE WHEN lr.sender_id = 8 AND lr.recipient_id IS NOT NULL AND lr.recipient_id <> 8 THEN lr.recipient_id
         WHEN lr.recipient_id = 8 AND lr.sender_id IS NOT NULL AND lr.sender_id <> 8 THEN lr.sender_id
    END AS counterpart_id,
    CASE WHEN lr.sender_id = 8 THEN 'out' WHEN lr.recipient_id = 8 THEN 'in' END AS direction,
    d.category,
    try_cast(split_part(l.doc_id, '-', 1) AS INTEGER) AS box
FROM letters l
JOIN letters_resolved lr ON lr.letter_id = l.letter_id
JOIN documents d ON d.doc_id = l.doc_id
WHERE l.doc_type <> 'blank';

summary.sql:
-- Key figures of the PDAI collection.
SELECT
    (SELECT count(*) FROM documents WHERE category IS NOT NULL AND category <> '') AS n_documents,
    (SELECT sum(pages) FROM documents) AS n_pages,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM letters) AS n_records,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM letters WHERE doc_type = 'blank') AS n_blank,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM u) AS n_units,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM u WHERE y IS NOT NULL) AS n_dated,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM u WHERE direction IS NOT NULL) AS n_karman_units,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM u WHERE direction = 'out') AS n_karman_out,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM u WHERE direction = 'in') AS n_karman_in,
    (SELECT count(DISTINCT counterpart_id) FROM u) AS n_counterparts,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM ent_canonical WHERE kind = 'person') AS n_persons,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM ent_canonical WHERE kind = 'institution') AS n_institutions,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM ent_canonical WHERE kind = 'place') AS n_places,
    (SELECT min(y) FROM u) AS y_min,
    (SELECT max(y) FROM u) AS y_max,
    (SELECT count(DISTINCT box) FROM u) AS n_boxes_pdai;

documents.sql:
-- Document spine: one row per PDAI document with its unit counts.
SELECT
    d.doc_id,
    d.category,
    d.display_name,
    d.year_range,
    d.pages,
    try_cast(split_part(d.doc_id, '-', 1) AS INTEGER) AS box,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM u WHERE u.doc_id = d.doc_id) AS n_units,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM u WHERE u.doc_id = d.doc_id AND u.direction IS NOT NULL) AS n_karman_units
FROM documents d
WHERE d.category IS NOT NULL AND d.category <> ''
ORDER BY box, d.doc_id;

units.sql:
-- All non-blank units with the fields the Python aggregation needs.
SELECT
    letter_id, doc_id, letter_nr, page_start, doc_type, place, y, language,
    topics, sender_id, recipient_id, counterpart_id, direction, category, box
FROM u
ORDER BY doc_id, letter_nr;

persons.sql:
-- Canonical persons and institutions that occur as sender or recipient.
SELECT e.ent_id, e.kind, e.canonical
FROM ent_canonical e
WHERE e.ent_id IN (SELECT sender_id FROM u UNION SELECT recipient_id FROM u);

institutions.sql:
-- Institutions mentioned in dated units (one row per unit and institution).
SELECT DISTINCT u.letter_id, u.y, u.topics, e.canonical AS institution
FROM letter_institutions li
JOIN u USING (letter_id)
JOIN ent_canonical e ON e.ent_id = li.ent_id
WHERE u.y IS NOT NULL;

manuscript_units.sql:
-- Units inside the documents of the manuscript catalogue, with regests.
SELECT u.doc_id, u.letter_nr, u.page_start, u.doc_type, u.y, u.language, u.topics, u.regest
FROM u
WHERE u.category IN ('Manuscripts & Notes (Technical)', 'Manuscripts & Notes (General)',
                     'Lectures & Courses', 'Book Manuscripts')
ORDER BY u.doc_id, u.letter_nr;

sections.sql:
-- Sections of the Caltech finding aid named on the archive cover sheets
-- ("Section IX: Manuscripts ..."), with the PDAI boxes in which they occur.
WITH s AS (
    SELECT
        regexp_extract(regest, 'Section ([IVXL]+)', 1) AS section,
        lower(regexp_extract(regest, 'Section [IVXL]+[:,]? ?[(''"]?([A-Za-z][A-Za-z &\-]+)', 1)) AS name,
        try_cast(split_part(doc_id, '-', 1) AS INTEGER) AS box
    FROM letters
    WHERE regexp_matches(regest, 'Section [IVXL]+')
)
SELECT section,
       arg_max(name, cnt) AS name,
       min(bmin) AS box_min,
       max(bmax) AS box_max,
       sum(cnt) AS n_cover_sheets
FROM (
    SELECT section, name, count(*) AS cnt, min(box) AS bmin, max(box) AS bmax
    FROM s
    WHERE name LIKE 'personal correspondence%' OR name LIKE 'technical files%'
       OR name LIKE 'publication correspondence%' OR name LIKE 'manuscripts%'
    GROUP BY section, name
)
GROUP BY section
ORDER BY box_min;

evidence.sql:
-- Earliest dated units whose regest contains a search term ($term is bound by build_data.py).
SELECT date_when, letter_id, doc_id, page_start, regest
FROM u
WHERE y IS NOT NULL AND regest ILIKE '%' || $term || '%'
ORDER BY date_when
LIMIT 3;

counting_rules: Blank pages (doc_type = 'blank') are excluded from every count.
Timelines count units with a year in date_when between 1890 and 1970.
Kármán correspondence: units with Kármán (ent_id 8) as sender or recipient.
Topics: tags in topics.yaml `exclude` are archive boilerplate and not counted; `synonyms` are merged.
Institutions: units tagged 'archival' and the boilerplate institutions are not counted.
Manuscript years are read from the folder slug only; no date is inferred.
